actinium.options.title: Video Settings
actinium.options.description.idle: Point at a setting to see what it does and what it costs.
actinium.options.flag.requires_game_rest: Takes effect on the next launch.
actinium.options.unavailable.fullscreenO: Only used in exclusive fullscreen. Set Window Mode to Fullscreen to change it.
actinium.options.windowMode.tooltip: Windowed, a borderless window covering the screen, or exclusive fullscreen. Exclusive fullscreen uses the resolution and refresh rate below and can give the lowest latency.
actinium.options.resolution.tooltip: The display mode used in exclusive fullscreen.
actinium.options.refreshRate.tooltip: The refresh rate used in exclusive fullscreen. The choices depend on the resolution.
actinium.options.framerateLimit.tooltip: Caps how many frames are drawn per second. A cap below your display's refresh rate lowers power draw and fan noise at no visual cost.
actinium.options.vsync.tooltip: Locks presentation to the display refresh, so frames never tear. Off draws as fast as the frame limit allows.
actinium.options.guiScale.tooltip: Size of menus, the hotbar and text. Auto picks the largest scale that fits the window.
actinium.options.gamma.tooltip: How bright dark areas appear. Costs nothing.
actinium.options.menuBlur.tooltip: Blurs the world behind menus. Higher values cost a little GPU time while a menu is open.
actinium.options.viewBobbing.tooltip: Sways the camera as you walk. Costs almost nothing to draw.
actinium.options.attackIndicator.tooltip: Shows the attack cooldown under the crosshair or beside the hotbar.
actinium.options.autosaveIndicator.toolt: Shows an icon in the corner while the world saves.
actinium.options.renderDistance.tooltip: How far the world is drawn. The single largest cost in the frame: doubling it roughly quadruples the geometry the GPU has to consider.
actinium.options.simulationDistance.tool: How far entities and block updates keep running. Costs CPU, not GPU, so lowering it helps when the frame rate stutters rather than sags.
Which chunk rebuilds happen immediately on the main thread. Nearby or player-affected rebuilds remove visible pop-in around you and can cost frame time while building.
actinium.options.graphics.tooltip: Fast draws opaque leaves and simpler weather. Fancy draws transparent leaves and fuller effects. Fabulous is not available with the Vulkan renderer.
actinium.options.particles.tooltip: How many particles are spawned. Decreased and Minimal help in heavy redstone or combat.
actinium.options.clouds.tooltip: Draws clouds above the world. Fancy clouds are volumetric and cost more at long render distances.
actinium.options.ao.tooltip: Darkens block corners where light is blocked. Sub Block shades within a block face as well, which looks better on stairs and slabs and costs a little more to mesh.
actinium.options.biomeBlend.tooltip: Blends grass, foliage and water colour across biome borders. Wider blends make chunk rebuilds slower.
actinium.options.entityShadows.tooltip: Draws a soft shadow under each entity. Cheap on its own, noticeable in a room full of mobs.
actinium.options.entityDistance.tooltip: How far away entities are drawn, relative to the default. Lower it for crowded farms.
actinium.options.mipmap.tooltip: Smooths distant textures. Higher levels remove the shimmer on faraway blocks and cost a small amount of VRAM.
actinium.options.builderThreads.tooltip: Threads meshing chunk geometry. Auto sizes the pool from your core count. More threads load the world faster and can starve the render thread while they run.
actinium.options.textureAnimations.toolt: Animates water, lava, fire and other animated textures. Off saves the upload each animated frame costs.
actinium.options.deviceSelector.tooltip: The GPU the renderer uses. Auto prefers a discrete card.
The GPU the renderer uses. Auto prefers a discrete card. In use now: %s
actinium.options.glContextBridge.tooltip: Gives mods that call OpenGL directly a real, hidden OpenGL context. Mods built on Veil need it to start. Anything they draw through OpenGL is not shown on screen.
actinium.options.interopEnabled.tooltip: Intercept OpenGL calls other mods make directly to LWJGL. This does not render anything yet: buffers and textures reach the GPU, but no draw call has ever gone through the layer. Leave it off unless you are developing Actinium.
